decisions.reason: As the flagship product line closely aligned with core digitalization and regulatory needs, it likely meets aspirations, so dropout probability remains very low.
Although not a software product, it builds on existing training resources and complements the core offer, and slack allows it to be carried, so I keep it with a moderate dropout probability.
The analytics dashboard fits the firm's direction toward data-driven practice management and is close to the established offer, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
The complete bundle is close to the established offer and mainly repackages existing modules, so it has a very low dropout probability and is kept.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core offer and likely underperforms relative to specialized job portals, triggering problemistic search and reallocation of resources, so I assign a high dropout probability and drop it.
